title: The backtest's doc says it replays a sprint with the items it ended with, filed mid-sprint ones included
goal: kb/_self/monitoring.md's Backtest bullet says that a replayed sprint's members are the items that named it at their claim commit by its close, so an item filed into the sprint mid-sprint counts as open at an earlier point, and a re-claimed item whose last claim is after the point counts as to do; or the replay takes each item from the point it joined the sprint

run: import re,sys;t=open("kb/_self/monitoring.md").read();b=[l for l in t.splitlines() if "--backtest" in l];print(len(b));sys.exit(0 if any(re.search(r"mid-sprint|filed into the sprint|joined the sprint",l) for l in b) else 1)

notes: SP-yjfiemha review, 2026-10-19, reasoned from mon_eta.backtest/replay_row and not measured: hindsight on the item set makes early points a bit pessimistic (BG-jemfbkjs, filed mid-sprint into SP-yjfiemha, would count as open at its 25 percent point).
